description: The City of Plzeň publishes the extent of the 100-year flood within the city as an open dataset, described as the flood areas of the n-year flood in Plzeň, with a link to a map application. The city is the data manager and the environment department of the municipal office is the author. Coverage is the territory of Plzeň, Czechia. The data are a free download in DGN, DXF, GeoJSON, KML and shapefile formats. The dataset was created on 27 January 2012; the page gives the last update of the dataset as 10 August 2026 and of the data as 20 November 2025, while the update frequency is listed as never. Caveats: only one return period is published here, the licence is not stated on the page, and the modelling behind the extent is not described. Simulation uses: flood exposure of city water, drainage and other assets for hazard studies. Related records: Czech hydrological open data from ČHMÚ (data-chmi-czech-hydrology-open-data) and the Czech dam safety supervision register (data-czech-mze-dam-safety-supervision-register).
